evidence.snippet: The Authentication API reads credentials and profile rows from the User Database.
Active sessions are kept in the Session Cache so token checks stay under 10ms.
Signing and verification are delegated to the Token Service.
The Web App exchanges its session cookie for an access token on every page load.
The mobile app calls /token on every launch and still sends the legacy token format on refresh.
Billing Service validates every incoming request against the Authentication API before touching an invoice.
Partner Portal logins are brokered by the Authentication API using long-lived legacy tokens.
Every token issue and revoke is emitted to the Audit Log Service.
This runbook covers rollback steps for the legacy token format issued by the Authentication API.
The Web App E2E Suite drives a full login flow on every pull request.
The Mobile App Test Suite pins a recorded legacy token fixture.
Billing Contract Tests assert the shape of the auth claims the service expects.
The Analytics Pipeline reads the Billing Service invoice stream hourly.
The Notification Service consumes billing events to send receipts.
On a delivery failure the Notification Service calls back into Billing Service to mark the receipt unsent.
The pipeline writes normalised fact tables into the Data Warehouse.
The Reporting Tool queries the Data Warehouse directly for revenue dashboards.
